text: Axiom K (Streicher's K) states: any two proofs of the same equality p q : a=a are:
choices: provably equal (there is a term of type p=q)
explanation: Axiom K: Π(a:A)(p:a=a). p = refl. This is the uniqueness of identity proofs (UIP) restricted to loops. K is independent of MLTT and inconsistent with univalence.
